VFC-A01.name: Extra limb, hand, glove or wrist
VFC-A01.description: A character has more than two arms, hands, gloves or wrists (third glove, three hands, a cuff with no arm).
VFC-A01.prevention_rule: Count arms, hands, gloves and wrists per character on every still and every animation frame; exactly two of each.

VFC-A02.name: Missing head or missing body part
VFC-A02.description: A body part that must be visible is absent: no head on a body, a limb that ends in nothing, a torso replaced by a shapeless mass.
VFC-A02.prevention_rule: Every visible arm must trace to a shoulder, a torso and a head inside the frame or leave through the bottom or a corner. A limb attached to a shapeless blob fails.

VFC-A03.name: Distorted, kinked or rubbery limb
VFC-A03.description: Limbs bend in more than one place, sag, stretch, snake, or have unequal upper arm and forearm lengths.
VFC-A03.prevention_rule: Zoomed crop of every arm: one bend at the elbow only, segments of similar length, no stretch or snake shapes.

VFC-A04.name: Impossible joint or reversed limb
VFC-A04.description: A joint bends the wrong way or a limb is mirrored (a right arm drawn as a left arm, thumb on the wrong side, twisted elbow, bent wrist at the glove).
VFC-A04.prevention_rule: Check which shoulder each arm leaves from and the thumb side; wrists straight behind the glove.

VFC-A05.name: Bare fist or wrong glove type
VFC-A05.description: A glove drawn with separate fingers like a bare fist, or bare hands where gloves are locked.
VFC-A05.prevention_rule: Hero gloves are black MMA gloves with red wrist straps exactly as drawn on the reference sheet (visible finger segments are correct, Sean C4 ruling 2026-11-24); fail bare fists, loose open fingers, peach hands or boxing gloves (bare hands only in a grip tutorial).

VFC-A06.name: Bodies merged or limbs tangled
VFC-A06.description: Two characters' limbs, heads or torsos merge or tangle so ownership of a limb is unclear; guards intersect at pocket range.
VFC-A06.prevention_rule: For every limb, name its owner. Any limb whose owner is unclear fails. Keep a visible gap between torsos.

VFC-A07.name: Disproportion or lens distortion
VFC-A07.description: Oversized deltoid or feet, fisheye giant feet, limbs or body parts out of scale with the character sheet.
VFC-A07.prevention_rule: Compare proportions with the reference sheet; no body part more than about 1.3x its reference size relative to the head.

VFC-B01.name: Hook drawn as a straight or open arm
VFC-B01.description: A hook with an elbow of 120 to 180 degrees that reads as a jab or body jab instead of a 90 degree L.
VFC-B01.prevention_rule: Hooks: elbow about 90 degrees (fail outside 70 to 110), forearm level, elbow at glove height (hook_rules.md).

VFC-B02.name: Hook elbow height or forearm angle wrong
VFC-B02.description: Hook elbow above or below the glove, forearm sloping, upper arm vertical with a low elbow.
VFC-B02.prevention_rule: Elbow level with the glove, forearm level; check in a zoomed crop.

VFC-B03.name: Uppercut or shovel with the elbow off the hip
VFC-B03.description: Shovel or uppercut drawn as a long reaching arm, horizontal punch or diagonal forearm with the elbow away from the hip.
VFC-B03.prevention_rule: Uppercuts and shovels: elbow at the own hip, forearm 70 to 85 degrees from horizontal, glove rising under the ribs or chin.

VFC-B04.name: Straight punch kinked, sagging or overlong
VFC-B04.description: A jab or cross with a kinked elbow, a sagging forearm, or an arm longer than the body allows.
VFC-B04.prevention_rule: Straight punches: shoulder, elbow and glove in one line, elbow at least 160 degrees, arm length matches the other arm.

VFC-B05.name: Guard hand dropped or elbows flared
VFC-B05.description: The non punching hand is off the chin, a guard glove sits at the hip, or guard elbows flare to shoulder height.
VFC-B05.prevention_rule: Non punching glove at the chin or cheek; guard elbows on the ribs (at least 0.45 x torso below the shoulder in the rig).

VFC-B06.name: Wrong technique drawn
VFC-B06.description: The picture shows a different technique from the one named: knee strike instead of a punch, cross instead of a jab, straight instead of a hook, idle guard.
VFC-B06.prevention_rule: Name the technique in the picture before reading the spec; it must match the spec and narration.

VFC-B07.name: Kick or leg mechanics wrong
VFC-B07.description: Knee against knee instead of shin, both feet off the ground with no planted leg, a shin passing through a leg, knee landing in the groin.
VFC-B07.prevention_rule: Kicks and checks: shin meets shin, one planted foot, no leg passes through another, knees land on the stomach or ribs.

VFC-B08.name: Motion phases wrong or kinetic chain missing
VFC-B08.description: Chamber, impact and recover frames are taken at the wrong moments, the glove starts at the target, the arm retracts on a different path or never returns to guard.
VFC-B08.prevention_rule: Chamber shows the glove at the guard, impact at full technique, recover back at the guard; check every in between frame, not only key poses.

VFC-B09.name: Implausible reaction or impossible pose
VFC-B09.description: Reactions no fighter would make (both hands thrown overhead from a jab), impossible crouches or poses.
VFC-B09.prevention_rule: Ask: would this happen in a real exchange? If not, regenerate.

VFC-C01.name: Wrong arm for the named punch
VFC-C01.description: Right arm on a left hook, rear hand on a jab, opponent's wrong hand.
VFC-C01.prevention_rule: Name the punching arm by owner and image side before checking anything else (hook_rules.md screen side table).

VFC-C02.name: Screen side swap without a motivated transition
VFC-C02.description: Fighters swap screen sides between consecutive shots, breaking the 180 degree rule.
VFC-C02.prevention_rule: Plan screen sides for the whole video; a side change needs a whip pan or a hard cut inside a montage (C14).

VFC-C03.name: Target on the wrong side of the body
VFC-C03.description: A liver shot landing on the spleen side, a target glow or label on the wrong side.
VFC-C03.prevention_rule: Orthodox liver = opponent's RIGHT side; check image side for every liver contact and target graphic.

VFC-C04.name: Wrong character performs the action
VFC-C04.description: The opponent checks the kick when the narration says the hero does, the partner swaps roles.
VFC-C04.prevention_rule: Confirm who acts in the narration and who acts in the picture.

VFC-C05.name: Head or face orientation impossible
VFC-C05.description: Eyes drawn on the back of a head seen from behind, a face turned the wrong way for the body.
VFC-C05.prevention_rule: Check that the eyes sit on the side of the head that faces the camera for that body orientation.

VFC-D01.name: Floating or detached glove, hand or limb
VFC-D01.description: A glove without a forearm, an arm detached from the shoulder, a hand with no visible owner.
VFC-D01.prevention_rule: Every glove and hand must trace through a wrist, forearm and upper arm to a shoulder.

VFC-D02.name: Feet floating or detached from the ground
VFC-D02.description: Feet hovering, both feet off the ground in a standing technique, heels below the floor.
VFC-D02.prevention_rule: Planted feet touch the ground line; one foot at least is planted in every standing technique.

VFC-E01.name: Face features on a faceless character
VFC-E01.description: A mouth, nose, eyebrows or scowl on the hero or opponent, or missing eyes.
VFC-E01.prevention_rule: Faces are blank with exactly two small slanted white eyes; nothing else.

VFC-E02.name: Outfit drift
VFC-E02.description: Wrong shirt colour, bare chest, shoes or socks, wrong glove type, red straps on opponent gloves, lettering on shirts, wrong format outfit.
VFC-E02.prevention_rule: Compare every character with the reference sheet for the format (long form black shirt, Shorts gray tank; opponent red tank, black shorts, plain black gloves; barefoot).

VFC-E03.name: Skin or colour drift and speckles
VFC-E03.description: Skin drifting tan or peach, discoloured heads, shorts drifting navy, speckles from colour cleanup.
VFC-E03.prevention_rule: Skin is charcoal everywhere; run the colour screener and inspect flagged patches at full size.

VFC-E04.name: Ghost, duplicate or extra character
VFC-E04.description: Reference sheet turnaround copies, the hero drawn twice, a faded figure, a third person in a two person scene, a partner in a solo video.
VFC-E04.prevention_rule: Count characters; exactly the scripted cast, no faded or turnaround copies.

VFC-E05.name: Opponent size or role wrong
VFC-E05.description: The opponent is not clearly bigger, proportions of the opponent change between shots.
VFC-E05.prevention_rule: Opponent about half a head taller with broader shoulders in every two shot.

VFC-E06.name: Style break
VFC-E06.description: 3D mannequin look leaking into the 2D style, emissive glow recolouring the costume, generic AI look.
VFC-E06.prevention_rule: Compare with approved 2D stills; reject any 3D shading or glow on the characters.

VFC-F01.name: Strike lands on a forbidden target
VFC-F01.description: Punches on the neck, throat, shoulder, ear, top of the head or chest centre; knee in the groin.
VFC-F01.prevention_rule: Strikes land only on chin, jaw or body (ribs, liver, stomach), with the neck visible and clear.

VFC-F02.name: Strike does not connect or a miss reads as a hit
VFC-F02.description: The glove stops short, passes behind, or a slip reads as a hit; the jab does not clear a dipped head.
VFC-F02.prevention_rule: Contact Law: every landed punch touches the target and compresses it; every miss shows a clear gap.

VFC-F03.name: Glove or limb buried inside the opponent or their clothing
VFC-F03.description: The glove disappears under the opponent's shirt or into the body instead of compressing the surface; fabric drawn wrapping over the glove.
VFC-F03.prevention_rule: At contact the whole glove stays visible on top of the shirt; the shirt and body dent inward around it. A glove hidden under fabric fails.

VFC-F04.name: Forbidden impact effect
VFC-F04.description: Bursts, flashes, white frames, sparks, shockwaves, glows or spiral swirls on a strike.
VFC-F04.prevention_rule: Speed lines drawn in code are the only strike effect (R11); image prompts say draw no effects.

VFC-G01.name: Head or body cut by the frame edge
VFC-G01.description: A head clipped by the top edge, an opponent sliced by a side edge, an arm entering mid edge, a sliver of an eye.
VFC-G01.prevention_rule: Nothing important touches the left, right or top edge; bodies leave only through the bottom or a corner.

VFC-G02.name: Text or graphic covering a head, face or the action
VFC-G02.description: Headlines, chips, CTA buttons or labels over a head or the strike.
VFC-G02.prevention_rule: Every overlay box must sit on background pixels only; check every shot an overlay spans.

VFC-G03.name: Camera hides the key action
VFC-G03.description: The punching arm hidden by the body, a profile head reading as the back of the head, contact behind the opponent.
VFC-G03.prevention_rule: Pick the angle that shows the lesson; the technique in the narration must be visible.

VFC-H01.name: Overlay or layer compositing error
VFC-H01.description: Alpha drawn at full strength, colour cleanup speckling cloth, background detection recolouring figures, overlay on the wrong body part.
VFC-H01.prevention_rule: Overlays on their own transparent layer; inspect the first and last frame of every overlay.

VFC-H02.name: Empty, frozen or dead frames
VFC-H02.description: Frames with only background, freezes, static holds over voice pauses.
VFC-H02.prevention_rule: No frame is mostly empty background outside intended cards; every second has motion.

VFC-H03.name: Transition or render error
VFC-H03.description: Flash during a whip pan, stale render from a stopped process, a shot one frame early, dropped tail.
VFC-H03.prevention_rule: Render to a new filename with no other render running; frame check every transition.

VFC-H04.name: Interpenetration in animation
VFC-H04.description: Gloves passing through heads, elbows into torsos, glove clashes in in between frames.
VFC-H04.prevention_rule: Check every animation frame, not key poses only; the rig collision metrics must be zero.

VFC-H05.name: Placeholder, watermark or reused crop shipped
VFC-H05.description: Placeholder labels, watermarks, crops of other shots standing in for a missing still.
VFC-H05.prevention_rule: No placeholder or watermark ever reaches a cut; reused stills at most twice and never adjacent.

VFC-H06.name: Stray lines, streaks or artifacts
VFC-H06.description: Stray floor line fragments, sky streaks, speed lines drawn in the wrong place.
VFC-H06.prevention_rule: Inspect edges and backgrounds at full size.

VFC-I01.name: Visual contradicts the narration
VFC-I01.description: The picture shows something other than what is said at that second (snap back with the arm still out, hands stay up with hands down, a sprint in a scene about gassing).
VFC-I01.prevention_rule: At each narration line ask: does the picture do exactly what the words say, right now?

VFC-I02.name: Caption or on screen text error
VFC-I02.description: Missing caption word, headline repeating the narration, chunks broken mid phrase, wrong counts, labels that do not match the picture (ELBOW ON HIP with no elbow on the hip).
VFC-I02.prevention_rule: Every label must be true of the picture under it; captions match the spoken words exactly.

VFC-I03.name: No visible change between beats
VFC-I03.description: One image reused for different concepts, two consecutive beats with no visible change.
VFC-I03.prevention_rule: One verb, one image: every beat has a start pose, an end pose and a visible change.

VFC-C06.name: Stance switched (southpaw instead of orthodox)
VFC-C06.description: The orthodox hero drawn with the right hand and right foot leading, or the jab hand flipping between shots of one sequence.
VFC-C06.prevention_rule: Orthodox: LEFT hand and LEFT foot lead in every shot; the same jab hand throughout a sequence.
